title: Analyticity of Lyapunov Exponents for Mixed Markov Quasi-Periodic Cocycles
summary: We study the dependence of the top Lyapunov exponent of a mixed Markov quasi-periodic cocycle on the transition probabilities. The transition matrix is assumed primitive, the Markov extension on the torus is assumed non-resonant along directed cycles, and the top Lyapunov exponent is assumed simple. We first prove the result in the irreducible case by a forward Markov transfer operator and contraction estimates uniform over the initial Markov state. The reducible case is then obtained, as in the Bernoulli argument of Bezerra-Sánchez-Tall, by decomposing along measurable invariant sections…
